# Contributing

Thanks for your interest! This is my **personal website**, so it doesn't take outside features or content. Small fixes are very welcome, though.

## Welcome

- 🐛 **Bugs**: something broken, misaligned, or not working on a device or browser
- ✏️ **Typos and wording**: in English or Persian
- 🔗 **Broken links**
- ♿ **Accessibility problems**: keyboard navigation, screen readers, contrast

The easiest way is to [open an issue](https://github.com/Usef-Farahmand/Personal-Website-Source/issues/new/choose). For a small, obvious fix, a pull request is fine too.

## Not accepted

- New features, pages, or redesigns
- Changes to my content (bio, projects, articles), apart from fixing mistakes
- Dependency bumps without a concrete reason

## Pull requests

1. Keep the change small and focused on one problem.
2. Run `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, and `npm run build` before opening it.
3. If you change text, update both languages when the same text exists in each.

The engineering standards for this codebase are in [`doc/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../doc/CONTRIBUTING.md).

By contributing, you agree that your contribution may be used in this website under the terms of its [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE).

Security issues: please follow [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) instead of opening an issue.
